theme: Light mode default (for high visibility in outdoor parking conditions). Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for mobile utility.

rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato.
Headings must use tight letter spacing.
Labels must be uppercase with wide spacing.
No full-screen gradients. Use flat, structural colors.
Hover states must be explicitly set and be a lighter hue of the active color.

layouts.mobile_container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#FAFAFA] pb-24 shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]
layouts.spacing: Use generous padding: p-6 or p-8 inside main containers to prevent text collision.
layouts.alignment: Left-align forms and dense content. Center-align the main search input to command attention.
layouts.grid: Use grid-cols-1 for all mobile views. Use small gap (gap-4) for lists.

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or sharp rectangle (rounded-md max 8px). Massive tap targets (min-h-[56px]) for the 'Call' button.
component_guidelines.inputs: For license plate search: Massive input field, centered text, mono font, tracking wide. For forms: Shadcn input, customized with 1px border, no shadow, bg-white.
component_guidelines.cards: Go cardless or use flat rectangular styles (max 8px border-radius) with 1px subtle border. NO blurry drop shadows.
component_guidelines.header: Sticky top, crystal glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-gray-200/50). Must not overlap content without padding.
component_guidelines.navigation: Bottom fixed tab bar (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 border-t border-gray-200) for switching between 'Search/Directory' and 'My Vehicle'. Do not use a hamburger menu.
component_guidelines.modals: Use Shadcn dialogs with solid backgrounds, NO glassmorphism for forms.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px sharp borders to create technical clarity.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Use ASCII art or simple Phosphor/Lucide icons with a muted, playful tone.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) on the background to remove digital flatness.

hero_background.description: Top view of a car parked, to be used with a heavy light/dark overlay as a subtle header background

community_building.description: Modern apartment building exterior for the welcome screen or empty state

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for all text. Focus states must have higher contrast with a visible ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='search-input', data-testid='call-button').

motion.interactions: Hover and active states must trigger slight scale down (active:scale-95) for tactile feedback.
motion.transitions: Use transition-transform and transition-opacity specifically, NOT transition-all.
motion.lists: Staggered entrance animations for directory list items (framer-motion).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first web app using React and Tailwind CSS.
Initialize Shadcn UI and add required components (input, button, dialog, tabs).
Do NOT use TypeScript. Ensure all components are in .js/.jsx.
Implement the directory data structure: id, ownerName, phone, flatNumber, vehicleNumber.
Since there is no backend mentioned, use React State or LocalStorage with mock initial data (at least 3 diverse vehicles).
Create a primary view with a massive 'Search License Plate' input. Auto-capitalize inputs.
Display search results immediately below. Each result must have a prominent 'Call' button wrapped in an <a> tag with href='tel:[phone_number]'.
Provide a full directory tab or section below the search.
Include an 'Add My Vehicle' flow via Shadcn Dialog.
Follow the typography scale STRICTLY. Max size is text-5xl.
Ensure 'Shiv Sampada Parking' branding feels premium, not like a cheap template.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This breaks transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations & color relevant to app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Only use provided image URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
